result.topic_en: Euler determines, for a prime divisor of each of the forms 12m+1, 12m+5, 12m+7 and 12m+11, whether +3 and -3 are quadratic residues, and remarks that this result was reached via cubes by a rather oblique route for which a more natural one is desired.
result.transcription:
124 RESIDVA EX DIVIS. POTESTATVM
quas singulas contemplemur.
I. Si diuisor primus sit formae $12m+1$, quatenus haec forma est $4n+1$, tam $+1$ quam $-1$ erit residuum; quatenus vero est $3n+1$, residuum quoque erit $-3$, hincque etiam $+3$. Hoc ergo in ordine residuorum occurrent $+3$ et $-3$.
II. Si diuisor primus sit formae $12m+5$, quatenus haec forma est $4n+1$, in residuis erunt $+1$ et $-1$; quatenus vero est $3n-1$ in residuis non reperitur $-3$, seu $-3$ erit non-residuum, hincque etiam $+3$. Quare hoc casu neuter numerorum $+3$ et $-3$ inter residua reperietur.
III. Si diuisor primus sit formae $12m+7$, quatenus haec forma est $4n-1$ erit $-1$ non-residuum, quatenus vero est $3n+1$ erit $-3$ residuum, ideoque $+3$ non-residuum. Vnde hoc casu erit $-3$ residuum at $+3$ non-residuum.
IV. Si diuisor primus sit formae $12m+11$, quatenus haec forma est $4n-1$, erit $-1$ non-residuum, quatenus vero est formae $3n-1$ erit quoque $-3$ non-residuum, vnde $+3$ vtpote productum ex duobus non-residuis inter residua occurret. Quare hoc casu erit $+3$ residuum at $-3$ non-residuum.
Ad hanc ergo egregiam proprietatem consideratio cuborum nos perduxit, quae via cum satis sit obliqua, alia magis naturalis maxime desideratur.
Proble-

items.quote: Si diuisor primus sit formae $12m+1$, quatenus haec forma est $4n+1$, tam $+1$ quam $-1$ erit residuum; quatenus vero est $3n+1$, residuum quoque erit $-3$, hincque etiam $+3$.
items.english: If the prime divisor is of the form 12m+1, then since this form is 4n+1, both +1 and -1 will be residues; and since it is 3n+1, -3 will also be a residue, and hence +3 as well.

items.quote: Quare hoc casu neuter numerorum $+3$ et $-3$ inter residua reperietur.
items.english: Therefore in this case (prime of form 12m+5) neither of the numbers +3 and -3 will be found among the residues.

items.quote: Vnde hoc casu erit $-3$ residuum at $+3$ non-residuum.
items.english: Hence in this case (prime of form 12m+7) -3 will be a residue but +3 a non-residue.

items.quote: Quare hoc casu erit $+3$ residuum at $-3$ non-residuum.
items.english: Therefore in this case (prime of form 12m+11) +3 will be a residue but -3 a non-residue.

items.quote: Ad hanc ergo egregiam proprietatem consideratio cuborum nos perduxit, quae via cum satis sit obliqua, alia magis naturalis maxime desideratur.
items.english: Thus the consideration of cubes has led us to this remarkable property; since this route is rather oblique, another, more natural one is greatly to be desired.
